What is actually being estimated?

Additional purchases from assignment to advertising eligibility, compared with targeting nobody, in this released benchmark. Assignment does not guarantee an ad impression. Doubly robust estimates are checked against inverse-probability weighting (IPW).

Why not simply target likely buyers?

Some likely buyers purchase anyway. Uplift models try to identify whose purchase probability changes because of advertising. Here, the selected uplift model did not clearly improve on the likely-buyer strategy.

What can’t these results prove?

The publisher altered incrementality through privacy subsampling. Anonymous features, missing dates and missing advertiser identifiers limit interpretation. Intervals assume independent users, condition on fitted models and omit training uncertainty. Audience scaling assumes the same population mix; it is not a forecast for a new business.

What should a business do next?

Run a fresh randomized experiment comparing complete targeting policies at equal cost. Predefine the economically meaningful improvement and measure actual costs and margins before rollout.
